newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent unleaded prices rebound with NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent unleaded prices rebound with NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel prices rose on Wednesday, tracking futures prices that rebounded sharply higher on short-covering late in the day, traders said.
Unleaded gasoline differentials were largely unchanged in the Group Three and Chicago spot markets despite bearish inventory estimates and reports of plentiful stocks on hand.
Gasoline inventories at Midwest refineries rose 691,000 barrels over the past week, the American Petroleum Institute said in its weekly petroleum survey released on Tuesday.

The gasoline build comes in the wake of Williams Pipeline Co estimates that its system feeding into the Group Three market was carrying high inventories of unleaded gasoline, premium gasoline and high sulphur diesel fuel.
High sulphur diesel was steady at bids 6.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil in Chicago and 8.50 cents under the print in Group Three.
Unleaded gasoline was unchanged at bids 0.50 cent a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in Chicago and firmed to 3.75 cents under the print in Group Three, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel was bid 5.0 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and 4.50 cents under in Group Three, and jet/kero differentials also were unchanged, traders said.
